items: display: flex and flex-wrap: wrap make the cards responsive, wrapping to the next line on smaller screens.
justify-content: center aligns the cards in the center, and gap: 20px provides space between them.
max-width: 1200px keeps the layout contained on larger screens.

blocks.content: In .card, consistent styles (background, shadow, and rounded corners) for an elegant and cohesive look.
This setup displays each blog card in a responsive, centered grid layout that looks good on both desktop and mobile screens.
